definitions.gloss: Buddha statue; Buddhist image; Buddhist sculpture
definitions.explanation: A statue or image representing Buddha or other Buddhist deities, typically found in temples and used as objects of worship or artistic appreciation.

examples.english: There is an old Buddha statue in the temple.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{仏像|ぶつぞう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国宝|こくほう}→国宝：09642_kokuhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This Buddha statue has been designated as a national treasure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大仏|だいぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{仏像|ぶつぞう}だ。
examples.english: The Great Buddha of Nara is a famous Buddhist statue.

notes:
{仏像|ぶつぞう} refers to any statue or sculpture depicting Buddha or other Buddhist figures. The term covers everything from massive temple statues to small household altar figures.

FORMS:
{仏|ぶつ} (Buddha) + ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (statue, image)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏像|ぶつぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{彫|ほ}る→彫る：00114_horu⟧: to carve a Buddhist statue
- {仏像|ぶつぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拝|おが}む→拝む：00328_ogamu⟧: to pray to a Buddhist statue
- ⟦{木造|もくぞう}→木造：08328_mokuzou⟧{仏像|ぶつぞう}: wooden Buddhist statue
